name: SmartBuildSim
description: A synthetic-twin framework that generates reproducible smart-building sensor and event data for benchmarking AI models in building analytics.
reputation: Research/industry tool used in building-analytics and digital-twin communities but not a broadly standardized academic benchmark.
notes: Synthetic-twin data — risk of sim-to-real gap and domain shift; benchmark is multimodal and not primarily an LLM benchmark; performance depends on chosen downstream task and metrics.
